title: Parker meets Earl Bostic at Metcalf's
summary: Butler saw Parker and Earl Bostic open together at Metcalf's place, where Bostic's lightning playing prompted Parker to go to the bar.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: But those rough times -- that rough time, when I saw
him in person, heard him in person, was when he and Earl Bostic opened up together there.
I think you told me that on the tape earlier.
Well, there was something -- it seemed to me you told me something, you saw him with Lockjaw Davis or something, was that you?
No, no, no, Lockjaw was a demon too, you know?

Lockjaw was a natural demon. He is. No, no, but this -- he had to play up to this place, Metcalf's place. And he and Earl Bostic hooked up there and he was, he was making wind, fast like wind, and Earl Bostic was coming on like lightening wind, put lightening to him. Earl Bostic -- really went in to his stuff, and see, Charlie Parker may not have been an alcoholic drinker, drinking man, but he went to the bar and got three or four doubles and Earl Bostic was still playing and running those running those snakes, and Charles stayed at the bar. Didn't reply.
So, Bostic took the cake. Seems they had another guy
